description: This file is a shell script that defines a comprehensive suite of automated tests for Git's untracked cache functionality. It includes setup routines, various test cases, and verification steps to ensure correct behavior of Git's status command with untracked cache, sparse checkout, symlinks, and other features.

methods.name: sync_mtime
methods.description: Synchronizes directory modification times to prevent lazy mtime updates on some filesystems.

methods.name: avoid_racy
methods.description: Introduces a delay to avoid race conditions.

methods.name: status_is_clean
methods.description: Checks if the repository status is clean.

methods.name: iuc
methods.description: Wrapper for 'git ls-files' commands to manipulate untracked cache.

methods.name: get_relevant_traces
methods.description: Extracts relevant performance trace data related to read_directory operations from tracing logs.
